contexts.text: To intercept the communication... of higher things with lower. Signified.
This interception or desolation of truth. Signified.
As the influx of good and truth is intercepted...
That before the Last Judgment... much of the communication between Heaven and the world, thus between the Lord and the Church, was intercepted. General article.
(Then) the communication with their neighbours was intercepted. (The consequence.)
So that they intercepted the spiritual light and heat...
It would intercept the communication of the Lord with men...
Lest the communication and conjunction of man with the Heavens should be intercepted... it pleased the Lord to reveal Divine truth by means of the Word...

So long as these expanses remain, there is intercepted with men the communication with the angelic Heavens... and when this communication is intercepted, all the truth and good of the Word are falsified and adulterated.
